cases.note: Rows bound to superseded defaults keep their values after a scrub.

files.s.tsvz:
#_defaults_#	d1	d2
a	x
#_defaults_#	e1	e2
b	y

cases.note: A row bound to narrower defaults must not pick up the wider final defaults.
Rows read with and without stripping keep their values, and stripping stays on for later appends.

files.s.tsvz:
#_strip_trailing_whites_#	false
a	x 
#_strip_trailing_whites_#	true
b	y

cases.note: A filled cell and an empty cell both survive, and fill-empty stays off for later appends.
Scrubbing a snapshot again changes nothing a reader can see.

files.s.tsvz:
#_defaults_#	d1	d2
a	x
#_strip_trailing_whites_#	false
b	y
